name: Lauren McArtney
story: Lauren McArtney began at Eagle Technology as a GIS intern and spent nearly eight years with the company before announcing her departure in 2023. Her farewell account describes the professional relationships and learning developed during that period. The ArcGIS Online and LocalMaps presentations in the book belong to this early stage of her geospatial career.
Lauren McArtney presented ArcGIS Online and LocalMaps in 2018.
